title: Kiwi EuropaTickets to Planner

requiredBeforeEnable: Authenticated tenant access and any required consent for live provisioning
Verified live Team membership and authorized agent roster
PlannerAssignedAtUtc field and assignment capture/backfill verified
Planner plan, one bucket per roster agent, and connection permissions verified
SharePoint source/state lists and all edit/reference URLs verified

assignmentTimestampCapture.timestampSource: SharePoint version timestamp for the assignment-change version
assignmentTimestampCapture.onAssignment: Set PlannerAssignedAtUtc to the change-version timestamp.
assignmentTimestampCapture.preventSelfTriggerLoop: On the flow's timestamp-only follow-up event, Get changes must show Assigned_x0020_toId unchanged.
assignmentTimestampCapture.outOfOrderEvents: Compare assignment-version timestamps and never overwrite a newer timestamp with an older event.
assignmentTimestampCapture.bootstrap: Backfill the latest proven version where Assigned_x0020_toId changed to the current assignee. If the history cannot prove the time, leave it unset and exclude the ticket until the next assignment change.

authorizedAgents.bucketPolicy: Exactly one existing bucket per authorized active agent, including agents with no current tickets.
authorizedAgents.taskAssigneePolicy: Assign each mirrored Planner task to the Entra object ID of its ticket assignee.

exclude: Assigned tickets without a proven assignment timestamp
Tickets assigned to an identity outside the approved agent roster

ticketCard.title: #<ticketId> - <SharePoint subject>; fail above 255 characters rather than truncate
ticketCard.detailsFormat: Readable labelled ticket fields followed by complete description, resolution, sorted extra fields, attachment links, dated exchange history, source edit link, and ownership marker.
ticketCard.nativeDueDate: dueDateTime from the verified source date/time with timezone; null clears it
ticketCard.graphPayloads: planner-sync-core.cjs buildGraphPayloads returns separate task and details bodies. PATCH each using its own current ETag. Native task fields include title, priority, percentComplete, bucketId, assignments and dueDateTime; details include readable description, previewType and OData-escaped URL references.
ticketCard.managedMarker: KiwiPlannerSync:v1:<ticketId> stored in the canonical task details for recovery and ownership checks.
ticketCard.oversizeBehavior: Fail the item visibly without truncating, creating, or updating a partial task.
references: Every available TicketExchanges item edit URL

taskIdentity.uncertainCreate: Search all plan tasks for the exact marker before retrying. Reuse exactly one, create only if zero exist, and fail for operator repair if duplicates exist. A marked task without a state mapping is an orphan and must not be deleted automatically.

reconcile: Read and validate every approved active agent and unique existing bucket.
Read every page of ticket items, attachment metadata, and related TicketExchanges history.
Fail closed for an incomplete page, missing timestamp, unknown assignee, missing bucket, permission error, or unresolved source URL.
Compute 20 desired tickets independently for each agent using assignment timestamp and ID tie-break order.
Build complete canonical task details and references and enforce the 4000-character limit before writing.
Create or update the exact marked task, bucket, assignment, completion status, references and details using current ETags.
Persist mappings/fingerprints only after successful Planner changes.

Delete only tasks no longer desired that match both the state mapping and exact ownership marker; remove state rows only after confirmed deletion. A marked task without a mapping requires operator repair and is never deleted automatically.
Never delete or update unmarked human Planner tasks or any SharePoint ticket, attachment, or exchange.
plannerSync.changeDetection: Read current Planner details/references and compare them with the full canonical source payload each run; exchange and attachment changes do not necessarily change EuropaTickets.Modified. Do not duplicate sensitive source text in PlannerSyncState.
plannerSync.retryPolicy: Honor Retry-After for 429/503. Retry only safe idempotent writes. Search marker after uncertain task create. Fail visibly on unresolved task identity or any partial run.
plannerSync.loggingPolicy: Log run ID, operation, ticket ID, agent ID, task ID and error code only. Never log ticket descriptions, attachment content, or exchange message text.

PlannerSyncAgents.provisioning: Tenant provisioning requires authenticated access and any required consent

PlannerSyncState.provisioning: Tenant provisioning requires authenticated access and any required consent

tenantOperationsNotPerformedByRepository: Verify and bind the existing kiwi tickets plan; provision missing agent buckets without creating another plan
Create restricted PlannerSyncAgents and PlannerSyncState lists
Create and connect the Power Automate flows
prohibitions: Do not use Modified or Created as a substitute for assignment time.
Do not copy live tenant credentials, connection IDs, or tokens into the repository.
Do not truncate full ticket or exchange content.
Do not treat a partially completed run as successful.
Do not delete a SharePoint record or an unmarked Planner task.
